# Pricing calculator

> **DRAFT — pending Legal + Finance + Security review.** The interactive
> widget below uses `$X` placeholders for every rate. It will only ship with
> real numbers after Finance sign-off.

## Estimate your CoreLink bill

<PricingCalculator />

## Inputs the calculator uses

| Input | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Average storage (GB-month) | 100 | Hot tier only; cold-tier overflow priced separately. |
| Monthly cache hits | 1,000,000 | Hits are free; volume informs which tier fits best. |
| Cache hit ratio | 0.85 | Used to derive expected origin pulls. |
| Cross-region egress (GB / month) | 50 | Egress within a single region is not billed. |
| Plan | Pro | Sets base fee and included quotas. |

## Worked example (illustrative only)

> Numbers below are placeholders; real rates apply once Finance signs off.

```
Plan: Pro (base = $X / month, 1 TB storage, 10 TB egress included)
Storage used: 1.4 TB → 0.4 TB overage × $X = $X
Egress used: 12 TB → 2 TB overage × $X = $X
Estimated monthly bill: $X + $X + $X = $X
```
